about: hanzo.db: HANZO's only database, and only what HANZO itself needs (the owner 2026-09-28: "data stays in wid, never back to pfhanzo"): no record value, no delivery, no member or account. Tables are created from here and nowhere else; a table that differs is refused, never kept.

hanzo_locker.about: an agent HANZO holds: its folder and the sha256 of its code and manifest, checked on every call and run

hanzo_runs.about: every call and job run, refused ones too, by the agent's key and the job's: its state, its times, what was charged, a plain reason (never an agent's words); every count HANZO shows is counted here
